description: Keeps the clocking-in cards for the whole strip. Holds, without anyone thinking of it as records, a minute-by-minute account of where several thousand people were on any given day.
designNotes: Created 2026-09-12 with The Time Office. Quietly one of the most useful NPCs here: an alibi, a contradiction, or a pattern, all filed in a rack by somebody nobody thinks to ask. Name and manner open.
